text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup— where Gentildonna aimed to 
make history with back-to-back victories—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Gentildonnaaaaa!! Whoaaa...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The crowd's expectations of her had 
reached their absolute peak. Which meant—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It means the rivals will be marking her 
relentlessly. However—
choice_data_list: It has nothing to do with you, right?
It's nothing to do with you, right?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: If anything, this works in my favor—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Shaking them off all at once saves so much 
trouble, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now then. You are up first, aren't 
you—Eishin Flash-san?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
At the Tenno Sho (Autumn), I conceded 
victory to you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"However, from that day on, once again... 
Staying true to the basics, I steadily 
honed my strength."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Please, savor this to the fullest. —The 
proud power I have rightfully built up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on a second!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan-san.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
... N-No way, that's super scary after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I'm... I'm...—damn strong 
too!!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I never ran in the Classics either. 
...I've lost to all kinds of folks along 
the way."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: “Still... but! I'm a sore loser!”

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Because I'll win! So that... I can think 
I'm amazing again!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So "that" is where your true 
power lies.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
âAh, on Jordan's 'dan'... a Hercules 
beetle.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haegyaaaahhhh?!?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, Gentil. Did your summer get 
totally hyped? Like, washed up on the 
beach?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Once the beach festival opening is done, 
you know what comes next... right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Japan doesn't start with a G, it's a J. 
In other words, you won't be winning 
back-to-back."*

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Bound by the pact of my soul, I will win. 
...As a G!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —My, how lively.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Verxina-san. Forgive me for keeping 
you waiting."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It seems there are quite a few who wish to 
be my "rival"... It is rather troublesome.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, my turn has finally come.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I shall say it plainly. The 
apology is mine—for keeping you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"It seems everyone has their sights set on 
you, intent on taking you down."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yet! When it comes to you, I'm the one who 
knows you best of all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Your power, your strength! I have 
hammered it all into this body...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—For you, who have ended up becoming the 
strongest, the only Umamusume you should 
perceive as a threat... is me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for continuing to win for my 
sake.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Let's see just how low that gem-adorned 
head of yours will bow!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Chuckle.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho... Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"So many wonderful people have gathered 
here... I am truly honored."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"With such a gorgeous grand path, my 
hoofprints will surely stand out as well."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us compete! Show me the power you 
have so painstakingly refined—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I shall crush every single bit of it for 
you!
